understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Ein Größenpfeil gehört zum Körper oder Messpunkt an seinem Fuß. Richtung und maßstäbliche Länge codieren Richtung und Betrag der Größe; die Spitzenlage ist keine zweite Ortsangabe. Ein Wechsel des Pfeilmaßstabs ändert die Zeichnung, nicht die Situation.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: A quantity arrow belongs to the body or measuring point at its tail. Direction and scaled length encode direction and magnitude of the quantity; the tip is not a second position. Changing arrow scale changes the drawing, not the physical situation.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person liest an einer unbekannten Skizze Träger, Richtung und Betrag mit Einheit ab, zeichnet denselben Pfeil mit einer anderen angegebenen Skala neu und erklärt die dabei verschobene Spitze bei unverändertem Körperort.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: From an unfamiliar sketch, the learner reads the carrier, direction and magnitude with units, redraws the same arrow with a different given scale, and explains the moved tip while the body position stays fixed.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Statt einer Wagengeschwindigkeit wird die lokale Strömung an einem ruhenden Messpunkt betrachtet; die Person setzt den Pfeil an diesen Punkt und verweigert einen Schluss auf Strömung oder Teilchenort an seiner gezeichneten Spitze.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Replace cart velocity by local airflow at a fixed measuring point; the learner anchors the arrow there and rejects inferring flow or particle position at its drawn tip.

descriptionReviews.rationale: Keep the actual final text. It still ties a quantity arrow to its carrier/point, reads and draws direction/magnitude with a given scale, and explicitly explains a changed drawn tip at unchanged position and physical magnitude. The new image legend now additionally names Geschwindigkeit. The description does not impose a later vector algebra formalism. DE and EN agree.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann in einer ebenen Skizze einen Größenpfeil dem zugehörigen Körper oder markierten Punkt zuordnen, ihn dort in der Richtung der Größe ansetzen und seinen Betrag mit einem vorgegebenen Pfeilmaßstab ablesen oder zeichnen. Sie erklärt an zwei Darstellungen derselben Situation, warum sich beim Wechsel des Pfeilmaßstabs die gezeichnete Spitze verschiebt, während Ort und physikalischer Betrag gleich bleiben.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionEn: In a plane sketch, the learner can identify the body or marked point to which an arrow belongs, draw the arrow there in the direction of the quantity, and use a given arrow scale to read or represent its magnitude. Given two drawings of the same situation, the learner can explain why changing the arrow scale moves the drawn tip while the body's position and the magnitude of the quantity stay the same.

descriptionReviews.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann mehrere Kräfte auf denselben Körper als dort ansetzende Pfeile mit einem gemeinsamen Kraftmaßstab zeichnen, in einer getrennten grafischen Konstruktion ihre Resultierende bestimmen und deren Betrag und Richtung für diesen Körper deuten. Sie unterscheidet dabei die Länge eines Kraftpfeils von einer Entfernung in der Skizze.
descriptionReviews.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can draw several forces on the same body as arrows starting on that body with a common force scale, determine their resultant in a separate graphical construction, and interpret its magnitude and direction for that body. They distinguish a force arrow’s length from a distance in the sketch.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Die Resultierende ist die gerichtete Summe der Kräfte auf denselben Körper. Ihre Pfeillänge folgt einem Kraftmaßstab in Newton, nicht der Ortsgeometrie; ein Nullresultat beseitigt die Einzelkräfte nicht und entscheidet für sich allein keine Drehwirkung.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: The resultant is the directed sum of forces on the same body. Arrow length follows a force scale in newtons, not position geometry; a zero resultant does not remove individual forces or alone settle rotational effects.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person zeichnet an einem benannten Körper Kräfte mit einer Kraftlegende, überträgt sie nachvollziehbar in eine separate Dreiecks- oder Parallelogrammkonstruktion und liest die Resultierende mit Betrag und Richtung für denselben Körper ab.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner draws forces on a named body with a force legend, transfers them traceably to a separate triangle or parallelogram construction, and reads the resultant magnitude and direction for that same body.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Nach einem nichtkollinearen Kräftepaar bearbeitet die Person ein kollineares gleich großes Gegenpaar und begründet das Nullresultat bei weiterhin wirkenden Einzelkräften, ohne aus der Summe allein die Drehung zu bestimmen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: After a non-collinear force pair, the learner handles an equal collinear opposing pair, explains the zero result while individual forces remain, and avoids inferring rotation from the sum alone.

descriptionReviews.rationale: The force description is unchanged and scientifically sound, but my precise wording objection remains: it does not explicitly separate arrows attached to the receiving body in the position sketch from the translated arrows used in a separate construction, or distinguish force-arrow length from spatial separation. Under the supplied standing representation criterion I retain revise and my bilingual local proposal. A revised field/video description elsewhere does not resolve this unchanged force text. This is an unresolved educational wording finding, not an assertion of a new false force law.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann mehrere an einem Körper angreifende Kräfte maßstäblich als Vektoren darstellen, grafisch zu einer resultierenden Kraft zusammensetzen und deren Betrag und Richtung im Kontext deuten.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can represent several forces acting on an object as vectors to scale, combine them graphically into a resultant force, and interpret its magnitude and direction in context.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: An einem Feldpunkt werden die dortigen Beiträge der Quellen vektoriell überlagert. Vorzeichen und Geometrie bestimmen ihre Richtungen; gleiche entgegengesetzte Beiträge können sich aufheben. Der Summenpfeil gehört weiter zu diesem Punkt.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: At a field point, the source contributions there superpose vectorially. Charge sign and geometry determine their directions; equal opposing contributions can cancel. The sum arrow still belongs to that point.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person bestimmt an einem vorgegebenen neuen Punkt die Beitragsrichtungen, zeichnet die Beiträge mit gemeinsamem Maßstab, konstruiert ihre Summe und erklärt eine Verstärkung oder Auslöschung aus den tatsächlichen Vektoren.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: At a fresh specified point, the learner determines contribution directions, draws them to a common scale, constructs their sum, and explains reinforcement or cancellation from the actual vectors.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei unverändertem Feldpunkt wird das Vorzeichen einer Quelle gewechselt oder die Quellengeometrie geändert. Die Person sagt die Änderung der Gesamtfeldrichtung voraus und überprüft sie grafisch, statt Einzelbeträge zu addieren.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Keep the field point but reverse one source sign or change source geometry. The learner predicts the total-field direction change and checks it graphically instead of adding scalar magnitudes.

descriptionReviews.rationale: The final wording now explicitly fixes the same marked field point, arrow tails there, and a shared field-strength scale, then asks for graphical addition and interpretation at that point. This resolves my earlier same-point objection without importing the quantitative-superposition successor. Its bilingual scope remains graphical and qualitative even though the word qualitativ is not repeated.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Beiträge zur elektrischen Feldstärke an demselben markierten Feldpunkt als dort ansetzende Pfeile mit einem gemeinsamen Feldstärkemaßstab darstellen. Sie addiert die Beiträge grafisch und deutet das resultierende Feld an diesem Punkt.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can represent contributions to the electric field at the same marked point by drawing arrows that start there and share a field-strength scale. They add the contributions graphically and interpret the resulting field at that point.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Haft- und Gleitreibung unterscheiden sich durch fehlendes beziehungsweise vorhandenes Gleiten der beiden Kontaktflächen. Die Kraft auf den gewählten Körper wirkt gegen dessen drohendes oder tatsächliches Gleiten relativ zum Partner, nicht notwendig gegen seine Bewegung relativ zum Boden.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Static and sliding friction differ by absence or presence of relative sliding at the two contact surfaces. The force on the chosen body opposes its impending or actual sliding relative to its partner, not necessarily its motion relative to the ground.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person benennt beide Kontaktflächen und den betrachteten Körper, begründet daraus Reibungsart und Kraftrichtung und erklärt bei veränderter Belastung das Anpassen der Haftreibung beziehungsweise den Übergang zum Gleiten.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner identifies both contact surfaces and the chosen body, uses them to justify friction regime and force direction, and explains static-friction adjustment or the onset of sliding when loading changes.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Nach einer waagerecht gezogenen Kiste wird eine zunehmend geneigte raue Ebene gegeben; die Person leitet die hangaufwärts gerichtete Reibung vor und nach Gleitbeginn aus der drohenden beziehungsweise tatsächlichen Relativbewegung ab.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: After a horizontally pulled crate, present a rough plane with increasing slope; the learner derives uphill friction before and after sliding from impending or actual relative motion.

descriptionReviews.rationale: Keep the final unchanged description. It states the contact-relative distinction between impending and actual sliding, requires the corresponding friction direction, and asks for its effect on motion. The corrected card now stays within that qualitative boundary. The old illustration’s unrestricted ground-motion caption does not invalidate this better description.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Haft- und Gleitreibung anhand der drohenden beziehungsweise bestehenden Relativbewegung an der Kontaktfläche unterscheiden, die Reibungskraft jeweils entgegen dieser Relativbewegung oder Relativbewegungstendenz einzeichnen und ihre Wirkung auf die Bewegung erläutern.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can distinguish static and sliding friction by whether relative motion at the contact is impending or occurring, draw the frictional force opposite that relative motion or tendency to move, and explain its effect on the motion.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Ortsänderung geteilt durch Zeitintervall liefert eine mittlere Geschwindigkeit. Für ein kurzes Fenster kann sie einem Zeitpunkt nur näherungsweise zugeordnet werden. Geschwindigkeit ist gerichtet; ein Richtungswechsel kann bei gleichem Betrag ein nichtverschwindendes Δv ergeben.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Displacement divided by elapsed time gives an average velocity. Assigning it to an instant is only approximate for a short window. Velocity is directed, so a direction change can give nonzero Δv at unchanged speed.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person wertet eine frische kalibrierte Bildfolge selbst aus, dokumentiert Zeitfenster und räumliche Zuordnung, zeichnet die Geschwindigkeiten mit einer m/s-Legende und konstruiert v₂−v₁ separat von der Ortsbahn.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner independently analyzes a fresh calibrated sequence, documents windows and spatial assignment, draws velocities with a m/s legend, and constructs v₂−v₁ separately from the position trajectory.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Ein zweiter echter Clip verändert die Bewegungsrichtung bei ungefähr gleichem Geschwindigkeitsbetrag. Die Person zeigt an eigenen Pfeilen Δv ungleich null und erklärt erneut die begrenzte Zeitpunktzuordnung des Intervallmittels.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: A second real clip changes motion direction at approximately constant speed. Using their own arrows, the learner shows nonzero Δv and again explains the limited instantaneous interpretation of the interval average.

descriptionReviews.rationale: The final bilingual text now distinguishes planar position changes, short equal windows, arrows at the body positions with their own velocity scale, approximate assignment to instants, and a separate graphical difference construction. These are the exact physical distinctions I requested. Supplied calibration is retained; an independent calibration experiment is not silently added. The current profile now supplies the missing observable approximation evidence.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann in einer zeitlich und räumlich kalibrierten Bildfolge einer ebenen Bewegung aus den Ortsänderungen über kurze, gleich lange Zeitintervalle Geschwindigkeitspfeile bestimmen. Sie zeichnet jeden Pfeil am zugehörigen Ort des Körpers mit einem eigenen Geschwindigkeitsmaßstab, erklärt die näherungsweise Zuordnung zum jeweiligen Zeitpunkt und bestimmt die Geschwindigkeitsänderung in einer getrennten grafischen Differenzkonstruktion.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionEn: In a spatially and temporally calibrated sequence of images of planar motion, the learner can use displacements over short, equal time intervals to determine velocity arrows. They draw each arrow at the corresponding position of the body using a separate velocity scale, explain why the value assigned to that instant is approximate and determine the change in velocity in a separate graphical subtraction.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Die beiden Kräfte einer Wechselwirkung wirken gleichzeitig, gleich groß und entgegengesetzt auf verschiedene Körper. In der Bilanz eines einzelnen Körpers steht seine empfangene Kraft; erst im gemeinsamen System sind beide Kräfte innere Kräfte und heben sich in ihrer Summe auf.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: An interaction’s two forces are simultaneous, equal in magnitude and opposite, and act on different bodies. A single-body balance contains that body’s received force; only in the combined system are both forces internal and cancel in their sum.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person benennt bei einer neuen Kontakt- oder Fernwechselwirkung beide Kraftausübenden und -empfänger in Worten, erklärt Gleichzeitigkeit und Betragsgleichheit und unterscheidet das Paar von Gewicht und Normalkraft auf einem einzelnen Körper. Eine Zeichnung ist eine mögliche Darstellung, kein notwendiger Nachweis.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: For a fresh contact or non-contact interaction, the learner verbally names each force agent and receiver, explains simultaneity and equal magnitude, and distinguishes the pair from weight and normal force on one body. Drawing is an optional representation rather than required evidence.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei zwei magnetisch wechselwirkenden Wagen wird einer festgeklemmt. Die Person ordnet Magnet- und Klemmkraft dem gehaltenen Wagen zu, erhält das Magnetkraftpaar und erklärt dessen innere Aufhebung nur für das gemeinsame System beider Wagen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: One of two magnetically interacting carts is clamped. The learner assigns magnetic and clamp forces to the held cart, preserves the magnetic pair, and explains its internal cancellation only for the combined two-cart system.

descriptionReviews.rationale: Keep the actual unchanged formulation of simultaneous equal-magnitude opposite forces between two interacting bodies. The new profile correctly permits verbal receiver assignment and qualifies the car/truck acceleration comparison by excluding other forces along the impact direction. The description remains a concise law competence rather than a mandatory drawing test.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Newtons drittes Axiom formulieren und an Beispielen erläutern, dass zwei wechselwirkende Körper gleichzeitig gleich große, entgegengesetzt gerichtete Kräfte aufeinander ausüben.
descriptionReviews.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can state Newton's third law and use examples to explain that two interacting bodies simultaneously exert equal-magnitude, oppositely directed forces on each other.

profileReviews.reason: The actual final profile retains the two correct independent briefs: a 6 m/s cart is rescaled from 3 cm to 2 cm while fixed markers remain 1.5 m apart; airflow at P is redrawn using two velocity scales and does not determine flow at Q. The deliberate coincidence between a tip and a position marker is questioned explicitly, not asserted as contact. Full carrier/scale/tip and transfer coverage remains sound.

The exact force profile still requires a force scale, graphical sum and physically bounded interpretation for a single ring. The 30 N east/40 N north case yields 50 N, while equal opposing 25 N forces yield zero without force absence. It correctly limits claims about rotation. This profile is adequate; it does not by itself settle my distinct concise-description wording dissent.

The actual profile agrees with the final same-point description. The midpoint/offset case and dipole sign reversal require independently determined source directions, common point/scale, graphical addition, justified symmetry and changed-case prediction. No numerical field-law extension is required.

The exact final profile is scientifically correct and still uses two independent contexts: a horizontal crate below/above its static limit and an adjustable incline before/after sliding. It distinguishes actual versus impending relative motion, the receiving body, static adjustment and motion effect. Given force values support qualitative decisions without requiring coefficient-law recall.

The new actual observable performances and first brief now explicitly require Δr/Δt interval means, approximate midpoint assignment with a physical explanation, arrows at the corresponding body positions with their own velocity legend, and a labelled separate difference construction. Both velocities belong to the same body and unchanged reference frame; the construction preserves a common scale. The second real clip changes direction at similar speed. This resolves my first profile revise decision. The stated condition of sufficiently small velocity variation within each short window makes the midpoint approximation defensible without imposing calculus.

The new exact third-law profile correctly distinguishes one-body balances from internal-force cancellation in the combined two-body momentum balance. Its acceleration comparison now excludes other impact-direction forces, so lower mass really implies greater acceleration magnitude for the equal contact forces. The clamp is correctly external to the two-cart system. Mandatory evidence can be verbal; optional sketches must be anchored and scaled. The profile tests the law and its receiver/system distinction, without requiring a separately scored formal momentum calculation or a mandatory arrow-construction skill.

prerequisiteReviews.reason: The final native and whole goal objects still require only the Why Physics orientation goal. My first finding remains: an orientation/motivation step with no subject-detail mastery is not necessary knowledge for this arrow competence. The current packet supplies its title/ID, not evidence that its competence has changed into a genuine prerequisite. This is a gate/modeling issue, separate from correctness of the accepted new description, image and card.

Qualitative force/inertia knowledge supports physical interpretation; proportional arithmetic supports the force scale; the new directed-arrow goal supports carrier/direction/magnitude. All three are specific to this operation.

The final whole-object prerequisite is still the component-wise vector addition/subtraction goal. In my first inspected material it required tuples in plane and space; the final title/ID and direct edge persist and no narrower replacement body is supplied. The final Physics description and both briefs still require only graphical local addition. I therefore retain the educational objection to requiring mastery of that stronger whole goal. This older gate has not been repaired by adding the elementary arrow prerequisite.

The current one-dimensional dynamics prerequisite supports qualitative force equilibrium versus acceleration in the supplied profile, and the directed-arrow goal supports the required drawing. It is defensible for the complete current evidence contract, although recognising the friction regime alone uses less knowledge.

The measured-change-per-time prerequisite supplies signed interval differences, quotient/unit and interval-versus-instant distinction; the directed-arrow prerequisite supplies direction, anchoring and arrow-scale interpretation. Graphical comparison is taught in this leaf; no later tuple-vector gate is necessary.

The new exact profile makes receiving-body assignment verbal and drawings optional. A mandatory arrow-construction prerequisite is therefore no longer justified by the required evidence. Its existing second-law prerequisite supports the explicitly conditioned acceleration comparison. I withdraw only the earlier missing-arrow-gate finding, on this concrete profile change.

memoryGoalReviews.reason: There is a distinct useful recall core: carrier, scale and changed drawn tip versus unchanged physical state. The existing directed-quantity-scale card supplies it correctly in both languages. No extra graph goal or new card is required; the independent drawing evidence remains separate.

The force-scale/resultant convention can usefully be recalled, but the distinct competence here is independent graphical composition on one body. The packet provides no force card and establishes no mandatory extra card requirement. A formula card would not replace the construction. No new memory leaf is needed.

Remembering same-point vector superposition is useful, but the current mandatory competence is independently constructing and interpreting that superposition. No distinct mandatory card item is missing from this supplied delivery; a later concise recall card would be optional and not evidence of that performance.

There is a distinct useful recall core: contact-relative direction and adjustable static magnitude. The revised bilingual friction card now supplies exactly it and removes the unclaimed coefficient formulas. My previous origin/prompt boundary objection is resolved.

No distinct mandatory card is needed for independent real-sequence analysis. A remembered Δv formula cannot demonstrate calibrated extraction, time assignment or separate construction. Current evidence appropriately requires real clips.

A distinct useful recall of the simultaneous two-body force pair is already supplied by the third-law card. The three-laws summary correctly binds all three origin goals. No new card for combined-system cancellation is necessary for this delivery, and neither existing card proves the independent verbal transfer.

cardReviews.scientificCorrectness: The vector equality, equal magnitudes, opposite directions, simultaneity and different receiving bodies correctly state the elementary Newtonian third law.
cardReviews.languageEquivalence: DE and EN preserve all those claims.
cardReviews.originFit: The sole origin is the third-law formulation/explanation goal.
cardReviews.promptAnswerFit: The direct law prompt receives the law plus the essential receiving-body qualification.
cardReviews.recallBoundary: Tests recall of the law; does not establish independent classification of force pairs or application.

cardReviews.scientificCorrectness: First and second laws explicitly assume an inertial frame; second law specifies constant mass and net external force. Third law states simultaneous opposite forces on different bodies.
cardReviews.languageEquivalence: DE/EN equations and conditions agree; S/K versus H/G coefficient notation is not relevant to this card.
cardReviews.originFit: All three Newton-law understanding goal IDs are listed. This is a joint summary rather than a card released solely by one law.
cardReviews.promptAnswerFit: Three-law prompt receives all three concise laws with their central conditions.
cardReviews.recallBoundary: Formula recall is not a dynamics calculation or force-pair diagnosis.

cardReviews.scientificCorrectness: The final card identifies a chosen receiving body and the relative motion/tendency of its contact surface against the other surface. Static magnitude adjusts up to a limit; sliding friction opposes actual relative sliding. No coefficient-law formula remains.
cardReviews.languageEquivalence: Both final languages preserve receiving body, contact-relative direction, static adjustment/limit and actual sliding. German Haften and English sticking express the same contact condition.
cardReviews.originFit: Now fully within the qualitative-friction understanding goal; no unsupported quantitative release origin is needed.
cardReviews.promptAnswerFit: The prompt asks the force direction during sticking/sliding, and the answer gives that distinction with the useful static-adjustment qualification.
cardReviews.recallBoundary: A conceptual recall item, not proof of independent contact classification, a force drawing or transfer to a moving contact partner.

cardReviews.scientificCorrectness: At unchanged 4 m/s rightward and equal-length reference bars, an arrow first spans two bars then one; its carrier and physical velocity remain unchanged while the drawn tip moves.
cardReviews.languageEquivalence: DE and EN preserve equal reference-bar length, 2 versus 4 m/s, unchanged cart position and velocity, and two-versus-one lengths.
cardReviews.originFit: Directly matches the early arrow-scale understanding goal.
cardReviews.promptAnswerFit: The changed-scale question receives both the altered drawing and invariant physical properties.
cardReviews.recallBoundary: Only recalls this comparison; does not establish independently locating the tail or transferring to a fixed field/measuring point.

imageReviews.anchorReference: Both arrows begin at the marked centre of the same cart; the track/cart configuration stays fixed. The track is the implicit velocity reference.
imageReviews.quantityScale: The final legend explicitly names Geschwindigkeit and Pfeilmaßstab, then labels the two bars 2 m/s and 4 m/s. The upper arrow visibly spans two upper reference bars and the lower arrow one lower reference bar. The two bar lengths need not be identical for this image’s stated two-versus-one comparison; the separate text-only card explicitly specifies its own equal-bar case.
imageReviews.tip: Both tips end in empty space. Changing their drawn positions does not move the cart or change its 4 m/s velocity.
imageReviews.readingAt360Px: Actually viewed the final 360 px derivative. Geschwindigkeit/Pfeilmaßstab is smaller than the old single-line caption but readable; 2 m/s, 4 m/s, the cart anchor marks and the arrow-length contrast remain clear.
limitations: This is teaching support; no independent learner performance was observed.
The image does not explicitly label the reference frame, but the stationary track supplies a clear local comparison.
No automatic approval of other images follows from this image verdict.

legacyImageFindings.tip: The tips are not on another physical charge.
legacyImageFindings.addition: The depicted resultant does not close the parallelogram of its shown components. At full resolution P is near (1274,860), E1 tip near (1720,860), E2 tip near (1274,390), but resultant tip near (1875,390). The resultant horizontal component is therefore visibly too long; the dashed right side is slanted instead of parallel to the vertical E2 contribution. This is a scientific drawing defect even for a qualitative addition picture.
legacyImageFindings.readingAt360Px: Viewed at 360 px: P, both positive sources and E1/E2/Eges labels remain legible. The stretched resultant still does not close the component parallelogram.

limitations: Existing image defect, not caused by adding a prerequisite edge.
